get_auth_config: get the global AuthConfig singleton instance parsed from the AUTH_JWT_SECRET environment variable
set_auth_config: set the global AuthConfig instance for testing purposes
create_AuthConfig: create an AuthConfig pydantic model with a jwt_secret and optional oauth github credentials
review_AuthConfig: review the AuthConfig pydantic model fields including jwt_secret, token_expiry_days, and oauth fields
refactor_auth_config: refactor the get_auth_config function to support custom environment variable names for the jwt secret
